query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Prepare marketing and CRM automation work: gather marketing performance data, send a brief by email, analyze search query data, and scaffold a HubSpot customer follow-up campaign with custom properties, email drafts, and bulk contact updates.

results.use_case: setup HubSpot customer campaign custom properties emails and contacts
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Check if the contact property already exists using HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME (avoid collisions; if present, confirm current definition before create vs update).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm an appropriate contact property group using HUBSPOT_READ_PROPERTY_GROUPS_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE (choose an existing groupName).
[Optional (if no suitable group exists)] [Prerequisite]: Create a new contact property group using HUBSPOT_CREATE_AND_RETURN_A_NEW_PROPERTY_GROUP (capture returned groupName for reuse).

[Required] [Step]: Create the custom contact property using HUBSPOT_CREATE_PROPERTY_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE (set name/label/type/fieldType/groupName; for enumeration include a valid options list; ensure type↔fieldType pairing is valid).
[Fallback] [Fallback]: If creation fails with 400 schema validation, retry HUBSPOT_CREATE_PROPERTY_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE after correcting type/fieldType and (if enumeration) options format.
[Required] [Next Step]: Verify the property using HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME (confirm label, type/fieldType, groupName, and options match expectations).

[Optional (if definition needs allowed edits)] [Next Step]: Update permitted fields using HUBSPOT_UPDATE_SPECIFIC_CRM_PROPERTY (e.g., label/description/visibility and allowed enumeration option adjustments).
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME] Lookup uses the internal property name (not the UI label); missing property returns 404 (OBJECT_NOT_FOUND / Properties.PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND) and is typically safe-to-create.
[HUBSPOT_READ_PROPERTY_GROUPS_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE] Groups are under data.results; groupName must match exactly or create validation fails.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_AND_RETURN_A_NEW_PROPERTY_GROUP] Can return 409 Conflict with groupsErrorCode="GROUP_EXISTS" if the group already exists.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_PROPERTY_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE] 400 schema validation commonly stems from invalid type/fieldType pairings or missing options when type is enumeration.
[HUBSPOT_UPDATE_SPECIFIC_CRM_PROPERTY] Some definition fields are immutable after creation (notably type/fieldType); restrict updates to allowed fields.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and customer service platform integrating CRM, email automation, and analytics to facilitate lead nurturing and seamless customer experiences
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=hubspot. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="hubspot") to create a connection BEFORE executing any hubspot tools.

HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME.description: Reads a specific CRM property definition for a given HubSpot object type by its internal name.

archived.description: If true, retrieves an archived property definition; retrieves active property definitions by default.

objectType.description: Specifies the CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'deals') for which the property is retrieved.

properties.description: Optional comma-separated list of additional property attributes to return; consult HubSpot API documentation for available attributes and format.

propertyName.description: The internal, unique name of the property to retrieve (e.g., 'firstname', 'dealname').

HUBSPOT_READ_PROPERTY_GROUPS_FOR_OBJECT_.description: Retrieves all property groups in a single call for a specified HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies'), returning only the groups themselves, not the individual properties within them.

objectType.description: Specifies the HubSpot CRM object type for which property groups will be retrieved.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_PROPERTY_FOR_SPECIFIED_OB.description: Creates a new custom property for a specified HubSpot CRM object type; ensure `groupName` refers to an existing property group for the `objectType`.

name.description: Internal programmatic name (snake_case), unique within the `objectType`, used for API referencing.

type.description: The data type of the property.

label.description: Human-readable label for the property shown in HubSpot UI.

hidden.description: If true, hides property in HubSpot UI, lists, and forms. Defaults to false if not set.

label.description: Human-readable label for the option shown in HubSpot UI.

value.description: Internal value of the option, used in API calls and must be unique among all options for this property.

hidden.description: If true, this option will not be displayed in HubSpot.

description.description: Optional description for the property option.

displayOrder.description: Controls display order of options, sorted ascending; -1 displays after positive values.

items.description: Request schema for individual property options, used when the property type is 'enumeration'.

options.description: List of predefined options. Required if `type` is 'enumeration'. For `fieldType` of 'booleancheckbox', must include exactly two options with values 'true' and 'false'. Each option defines a possible value.

fieldType.description: Controls UI display and interaction method (e.g., text input, dropdown, checkbox).

formField.description: If true, property can be used in HubSpot forms. Defaults to false if not set.

groupName.description: Name of the property group for organization in HubSpot UI.

objectType.description: Target HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., contacts, companies) for the new property. Case-sensitive.

description.description: Optional description for the property, displayed as help text in HubSpot UI.

displayOrder.description: Controls display order of properties in HubSpot UI, sorted ascending; -1 displays after positive values.

hasUniqueValue.description: If true, property's value must be unique across all records for the `objectType`. Cannot be changed to false after being set to true.

externalOptions.description: If true, 'enumeration' options are sourced externally, requiring `referencedObjectType` (e.g., 'OWNER' for HubSpot users). Defaults to false. Only for 'enumeration' type.

calculationFormula.description: Formula for calculated property, required if `fieldType` is 'calculation_equation'. Can reference other properties by their internal names.

referencedObjectType.description: For properties referencing other HubSpot objects (e.g., "OWNER" when `externalOptions` is true and `type` is "enumeration" to populate options with users). Applicable for specific property types.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_AND_RETURN_A_NEW_PROPERTY.description: Creates a new, empty property group for a specified CRM object type in HubSpot, requiring a unique group name for that object type; properties must be added separately.

name.description: The unique internal programmatic name for the property group within the specified `objectType`, used for API referencing.

label.description: Human-readable label for the property group, displayed in the HubSpot UI.

objectType.description: The CRM object type for which the property group will be created.

displayOrder.description: Order in which the group appears in the HubSpot UI. Positive values are sorted ascendingly; -1 places it after groups with positive `displayOrder`. If unspecified, the group is added at the end.
